title: After a Tricky Bug
intro: For after a stubborn problem. Nothing here is a test. It is just a moment to look back.

prompts.text: What was the first clue that something was off?
What did you try that did not work, and what did it rule out?
What finally changed how you saw the problem?
What would have helped you find it sooner?
Is there a note, a test or a check you could leave behind for next time?
What did the problem teach you about the code, the tools or your own habits?
How did you keep going when it felt stuck?
What would you tell a friend who is facing the same sort of problem?
